ideas.pitch: An AI-powered campus navigation and micro-mobility management system that optimizes walking, cycling, and electric cart routes to minimize carbon footprint and traffic congestion around IIIT Delhi.
ideas.title: EcoRoute IIITD
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages a working live demo of GIS mapping combined with localized campus utility, fitting the Entrepreneurship Cell's focus on practical real-world student-centric innovations.

ideas.pitch: A rapid health-triage kiosk application for university infirmaries featuring multi-language symptom intake and basic rPPG heart rate estimation using standard webcams.
ideas.title: CampusCare Triage
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs hard engineering components like computer-vision rPPG monitoring that stand out immediately during a live demo judging panel.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous IoT diagnostic and anomaly detection dashboard for college computer labs and hardware workshops that predicts power surges and equipment failures using lightweight ML models.
ideas.title: SmartLab Ops
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates genuinely hard engineering via isolation forest anomaly detection applied to local IoT telemetry streams.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent personalized tutoring platform tailored to university curriculum syllabi, using LangGraph and retrieval-augmented generation to guide students through complex debugging assignments.
ideas.title: EduAgent Graph
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies a proven multi-agent architecture pattern that directly addresses student educational needs at an institute like IIIT Delhi.

ideas.pitch: A zero-knowledge proof credential verification portal for university clubs and hackathons that ensures participants can prove skill achievements without revealing underlying personal data.
ideas.title: VeriCert ZK
ideas.why_it_could_win: Features advanced cryptographic utility (ZK proofs) which impresses technical judges looking for ambitious engineering within tight 24-hour constraints.
